# Tzu-Jung Li — Research Portfolio

> The public research portfolio of Tzu-Jung Li (李子榕), examining how intelligent networked systems make inference decisions under communication, computation, energy, memory and thermal constraints.

Canonical URL: https://z1ron.com/
Language: Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant)

## Profile

- Mathematics graduate with a double major in Computer Science and Information Engineering at National Chung Cheng University.
- Research Assistant at Academia Sinica since March 2026.
- IEEE GLOBECOM 2026 accepted paper, second author.
- First-author research on thermal-aware satellite AI inference.
